content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a project involving two [product_name] devices, trying to transfer a network output from one to the other's network input. However, this is not functioning as expected. Both devices reside in the same subnet and share the same subnet mask, default gateway, and their IP addresses differ by one. I included both devices in a network project and created a connection between their programs using drag and drop. During simulation, everything works as intended, but when I go online, the input doesn't respond to the output and stays inactive. Are there additional configuration settings I should verify, or might the issue be network-related?
Did you enable S7 access in the file properties for [product_name] [version_no]? Navigate to File > Properties > General.
I hadn't enabled that option. After enabling it, the communication now works.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced challenges setting up network communication between two devices. Simulation behaved as expected, but live network communication failed until the user enabled a critical configuration option—S7 access—in the project properties. This highlights the importance of making connectivity settings more visible to prevent them from being overlooked.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that network setups will operate consistently both in simulation and online, with network inputs accurately reflecting outputs when network configurations are set correctly.
